test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a row of students facing north, Krish is 19th from the extreme left end while Maya is 30th from the extreme right end. When both of them interchange their positions, Krish becomes 36th from the extreme left end. How many students are there in the row?
solution: The logic followed here is: Position of Krish from the left = 19th Position of Maya from the right = 30th
